character: One dry Kiwi storyteller (Cam S, ElevenLabs voice 53CG2aO2HU48thT3QnMl) telling the owner-builder's hunt as a flat incident report, quietly amused at the paperwork and a little at the owner ('sorry, me again'), never at the roofer ('fair enough' is meant). General NZ accent, never a caricature, no announcer lift, no exclamation marks. Product lines are second-person tips ('You check it, you tick it'), never 'I use it' or a result claim, so an AI voice never reads as a customer. Continuous speech: the narration never stops for more than 1 s.

settings.note: v3 only accepts stability 0.0 / 0.5 / 1.0; no style/speed/similarity

take.method: ONE unbroken request to /v1/text-to-speech/53CG2aO2HU48thT3QnMl/with-timestamps?output_format=mp3_44100_128 (model eleven_v3, stability 0.5); never sliced; laid onto the master at 0.0 s at gain 1.15 with tools/mux, no music bed. 2026-10-10 re-take (attempt 4) for the owner's CTA fix 'dot Co dot N Z' (2026-10-08); the 2026-10-07 take (attempt 3, 57.60 s, CTA 'dot co') is kept as take-attempt3.mp3. Line start_s are the HEARD onsets (alignment starts corrected with the audio energy, words-heard.json).
take.stt_check: tools/el.py stt (outputs/vo-take-cam-v3/stt.txt): every word heard; QSME heard as 'QS Me' (twice); the CTA heard as 'qsme.co.nz' (koh = the KO the owner asked for, 'dot en zed' = .nz)
take.max_gap_where: after 'So where is it?' (6.50 → 7.58, 'Inbox.'): the beat the whip to Search 1 lands in; every other pause ≤ 0.96 s (energy measure, -40 dBFS)

continuous_read_v3:
Everything's finished. Except one bit of paper. The roofer's Record of Work. So where is it? Inbox. No results. Garage, box three of seven. Not it. Search fourteen, the ute. A pie receipt. Not it. [amused] Good pie, though.

Text the roofer. Monday. Wednesday. Friday, sorry, me again. He's on a job in Queenstown. Fair enough.

Next build, the paper goes in while they're still on site. On Queue Ess Mee, the roofer records his certificate on your project before he leaves. You check it, you tick it. And the CCC pack is every certificate plus the council index, in one zip.

You still lodge it with council. Queue Ess Mee just ends the hunt.

Everything's finished. Even the paper. Sign up at Queue Ess Mee dot Co dot N Z.
